title: Erdős 956: unit distances between disjoint convex translates
abstract: A complete Lean 4 proof of the affirmative answer to Erdős problem 956: for all sufficiently large n, there exist n pairwise-disjoint translates of a compact convex planar set with more than n^(1+c) unordered pairs at Euclidean set-distance 1 (for c = 1/4). Adapting the parabolic construction announced by Valtr (2005) and detailed in Chojecki's April 2026 manuscript, the formalization proves the supporting-hyperplane theorem for a centrally symmetric signed parabolic cap and constructs a four-layer parabolic grid of disjoint translates. This establishes the explicit lower bound h(n) > (1/26) n^(4/3) for all n ≥ 80 and the sharper eventual bound h(n) > (2/5) n^(4/3).
